svg.title: HYDRA-UMC-VISION-STREAMER architecture
svg.desc: HYDRA-UMC-VISION-STREAMER validates a camera configuration, generates the GStreamer pipeline and the MediaMTX relay configuration for each camera, serves MJPEG from a bounded buffer with reconnection, and redacts secrets in its logs.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Camera configuration in, GStreamer, MediaMTX and MJPEG out, with every camera isolated from the others.
